project.name: osgi/domains/incus/incus-contract-host
project.description: The HOST face of the incus contract — the flat value views the pure-host GROW consumes. The GROW runs host-flat (outside Felix, com.pulumi lives there) yet is still the incus domain talking to itself across the realm boundary com.pulumi imposes: the scion (OSGi) PROJECTS an InstanceGrowPlan and the host GROW ACTUALISES it. type=library dual-realm, like seed-broker-codec: staged as a bundle OSGi-side (the scion assembles the plan) AND kept flat host-side (the GROW fetches and decodes it via the dual-realm SeedCodec). RECORDS OF FLAT VALUES ONLY — zero method-logic, zero com.pulumi, zero OSGi service reference; if behaviour crept in, this module would be the door through which it leaks host-side. Legitimate — and NOT a seam transgression — because producer and consumer are the SAME domain (intra-domain dual-realm), orthogonal to the inter-domain seam purity the contract-purity guard protects. See docs/architecture/osgi/host-cellar-realisation-spec.adoc § the-grow-anatomy.
